name: slang-lang
description: Slang language support: syntax highlighting and the slang-lsp language server (diagnostics with quick fixes, navigation, hover, rename, completion, signature help, inlay hints, formatting, semantic highlighting, code lenses to run tests) and debugging through lldb-dap with Slang value formatters

slang.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the language server executable. The default `slang-lsp` is looked up on `PATH`; if it is not found, `slang lsp` is used instead. A path to the `slang` CLI also works (it is started as `slang lsp`).

slang.serverArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to the language server.

slang.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the Slang language server.

slang.inlayHints.types.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the inferred type after names declared with `var x = ...` (and `for x in ...`).

slang.inlayHints.parameterNames.enabled.markdownDescription: Show parameter names before literal arguments at call sites (`Open(owner: "alice", initial: 100)`).

slang.path.markdownDescription: The `slang` CLI used to build programs for debugging (`slang build`) and to locate the lldb formatters (`slang debug --formatters lldb`).

slang.debug.lldbDapPath.markdownDescription: Path to `lldb-dap` (LLVM 18+; `lldb-vscode` in older LLVMs). Empty: look for `lldb-dap`, `lldb-dap-18`, ... on `PATH`.

slang.debug.formatters.markdownDescription: Path to `tools/lldb/slang_formatters.py`. Empty: ask `slang debug --formatters lldb`.

enumDescriptions: The in-process debug agent (std.debug): the program is started with SLANG_DEBUG=127.0.0.1:0,wait and VS Code connects to it over DAP (docs/DEBUGGER.md stage 2).
lldb-dap with the Slang formatters (stage 1; DWARF, needs LLDB 18+).
adapter.description: Debug adapter: the in-process agent (default) or lldb-dap.

program.description: Executable to debug (built with debug info: any non-release `slang build`, or `--release -g`).

source.description: A .sl file or project directory: built with `slang build` before launching when no preLaunchTask is set (`program` defaults to target/slang-debug/<name>).

build.description: Build `source` before launching (ignored with a preLaunchTask).

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the program entry point.

initCommands.description: Extra lldb commands run before the target is created (after the Slang formatters are imported).

preRunCommands.description: lldb commands run just before launching or attaching.

stopCommands.description: lldb commands run each time the process stops.

lldb-dap with the Slang formatters (stage 1; DWARF, needs LLDB 18+).

port.description: agent: port of the debug agent.

pid.description: lldb: process id to attach to (asked for when missing).
